title: Review: KDF UAPI, tests, tools, provider audit fixes
description: Pre-merge review of last two commits: 37df9b1 (fix: audit: zeroization, UAPI, observability) and 179f504 (feat: KDF UAPI, tests, tools, provider audit fixes). 2284 insertions across 20 files.
notes:
Maintainer risk: HIGH — Two issues warrant blocking: (1) DO_KDF in UAPI with no implementation is a broken API promise that ships in the header; (2) AEAD auth failure emitting pr_err will spam production dmesg under any attack scenario.
Confidence: 15% chance of missed bug. Uncertainty driven by: (1) KDF implementation is missing — couldn't review code that doesn't exist; (2) test_af_alg.c and test_chardev.c are new (340+513 lines) and weren't fully reviewed for test oracle independence; (3) wolfssl provider interactions with FIPS mode and WC_RNG state under concurrent reset were not traced end-to-end. Would raise confidence if: DO_KDF is implemented and reviewable; test vectors in tests/ are verified against an external oracle (OpenSSL, NIST ACVTS); RESET → INIT cycle is tested under concurrent load.
